description: Modbus RTU extension with 8 temperature measurement channels
source: Extension xG18 Modbus map v1.1, Unipi technology

sources.title: Extension xG18 Modbus map
sources.note: Holding registers, Coils and Description sheets

notes: The sheets inside the document are marked v1.1 although the file name says v1.0.
Registers are 0-based. 32-bit values use word order CDAB (low word first). Defaults: slave address 15, 19200 bps, 8N1.
Registers marked Reserved in the manual are left out.
